saints.name: St. Balthild
saints.title: Queen
saints.shortBlurb: An Anglo-Saxon slave girl who became queen of the Franks and used her power to ransom captives and forbid the slave trade…
biography: Balthild was an Anglo-Saxon carried off as a slave to Gaul, who rose in the royal household and was married to Clovis II, king of the Franks. As queen, and after his death as regent for her young son, she governed with piety and justice.

She used her authority to forbid the trade in Christian slaves, to ransom captives, and to found the great monasteries of Chelles and Corbie. At length she withdrew to Chelles as a simple nun and died there about 680.
saints.knownFor: Opposing the slave trade and founding monasteries.
